entries.reason: IF ws-counter > 0 in GET-MEDICATION-INFO (HCIMDB01.cbl:226): the loop PERFORM runs only while SQLCODE is 0 after OPEN-CURSOR, and the only arm of OPEN-CURSOR's EVALUATE that leaves SQLCODE 0 is WHEN 0, which PERFORMs LOAD-COMMAREA (ADD 1 to ws-counter, VALUE +0), so ws-counter is at least 1 whenever the loop FETCH returns 100. branch_solver reports a witness (EIBCALEN=18) because it does not follow the PERFORM UNTIL's ws-counter across iterations (ladder-slice: a plain PERFORM UNTIL counter's bounds are not modelled); the claim rests on the program text above, not on the solver.
